label: D1 after unrewarded a1->S1 (common), growing steeply with episode trial past ~70
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * np.clip(ep_trial-70,0,40) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * np.clip(ep_trial-70,0,40)**2 ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * (ep_trial>=70)
explanation: Fires only at D1. Magnitude is set by the interaction of the previous trial being a1 -> S1 (common) unrewarded with the episode trial: zero before ~trial 70, then a step plus a convex ramp reaching ~1.3-1.8 by trials 90-99. Other previous-trial patterns (incl. a2 S1 u, S2 unrewarded, any rewarded) give ~0; a2 S1 u after an earlier S1 loss adds nothing. GO and D2 are always 0. Profile additive ceiling (no interaction with time) is only 0.13; the last-trial x late-episode interaction gives dev R^2 beyond timing 0.75. Remaining misses are mostly D1 on the window first trial, where the previous trial is outside the window. No future variables used.

issues: Saying it 'jumps up' at trial 70 is not supported. Binned weights for D1 x last_is('a1 S1 u') on test: trials 60-69 0.004, 70-74 0.033, 75-79 0.12, 80-84 0.30, 85-89 0.58, 90-94 0.96, 95-99 1.37. That is a smooth ramp that starts around 75, not a step. The fitted (ep_trial>=70) step term has weight 0.010. Dropping it and the linear term changes nothing: the single quadratic term (phase==D1)*last_is('a1 S1 u')*clip(ep_trial-70,0,40)**2 alone scores test R^2 0.739.

'Reaching about 1.3-1.8 by trials 90-99' describes individual high-firing examples. The mean activation after a1 S1 u is about 0.96 at trials 90-94 and 1.37 at 95-99. Some late a1 S1 u D1 steps stay near 0 (in misses, one t98 step is 0.037). So part of the ramp may be a rising chance of firing, not only a rising size when it fires.

Confirmed: a2 S1 u does not fire. Adding a2 S1 u x late (with or without an earlier loss or an earlier S1 trial) leaves test R^2 at 0.739, and its binned weight is -0.02. A first-trial (unknown previous trial) late term gives 0.739, no gain. GO and D2 are exactly 0 in the baseline and residuals.

The worst misses are D1 on the window's first trial (previous trial unknown, actual 1.4-1.7, predicted 0.08). They are not an error class that observed terms can fix. Misses shows no other systematic phase x previous-trial pattern: all mean errors are 0.011 or less.

Small extra signal from model outputs: scaling the late a1 S1 u ramp by the policy logit (choice) raises test R^2 to 0.774, and adding value as well gives 0.785. The future variable action==1 gives 0.755. These are minor refinements, not a gap.
